prompt: If a show airs new episodes daily, premiered on May 19th 2010 and is still ongoing as of May 9th 2024 (the latest season will end on May 18th 2024, and the next season starts the next day), how many episodes and seasons (each season air between May 19th-May 18th the following year)
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 is the closest: it correctly identifies that by May 9, 2024 the show is in its 14th season, but its episode count is off because it mishandles leap-year inclusion and doesn’t properly account for the partial progress of the current (14th) season as of May 9. Candidate 2 provides an approximate and internally inconsistent calculation and lands on a substantially incorrect episode total. Candidate 3 does not answer the problem as posed (it incorrectly treats episodes-per-season as unknown), making it effectively a non-answer. Candidate 4 miscounts the seasons (13 instead of 14) and produces a very inaccurate episode total.
